changes: Tools are held properly: gripped near the end of the handle and turned side-on, so you swing with the head, not the flat
Tools in your hand are 1 pixel thick, for a little depth
Blocks in your inventory, hotbar and recipes show as little 3D cubes, including the kiln (with its opening); torches show as a small 3D stick
The + on blocks with other forms is smaller, neatly centred and tucked into the slot's bottom-right corner
Menus and the hotbar scale with your screen's display scaling by a whole number (150% makes them twice as big), so every pixel stays even
